text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: multiple hosts in inference-prod are reporting GPU driver resets and a recent spike of ECC correctable errors (brief Xid bursts). Auto-evac behavior kicked for some pods. Paging oncall.

tina-oncall: on it. seeing autoscale/evac logs. are we already failing customer requests, or are fallbacks working?

jamie-eng: some 503s from streaming endpoints (model-servlet) since ~4283456700. Not full outage but elevated error rates. Canary traffic still fine on region-eu.

sarah-ml: models pinned to v1.4 on these nodes, traffic heavy for short-seq generation. Could be KV cache pressure + driver resets.

dario-sre: pulling logs. here's kernel excerpt from node gpu-17 (shortened):
```
[ 24567.891012] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, PID 4210, GPU:0
[ 24567.891023] NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed!
[ 24568.012345] kworker/3:2: process oom_killer: killing containerd-shim
[ 24568.012400] inference-serve-abc terminated with OOM
[ 24568.112500] ecc: client reported cc error: GPU0 correctable count 78 -> spike
```

dario-sre: also seeing repeated `nvidia-mig` detach/attach in syslog before driver reset. Not a graceful driver unload.

lee-platform: infra-bot shows node GPU temperature normal, power stable. Kernel versions match fleet. Could be a transient kernel-driver interaction tied to heavy KV cache churn.

tina-oncall: @jamie-eng please shift canary traffic to eu, and add temporary routing rule to prefer dedicated-fallback model for high-latency requests. @dario-sre start targeted evacuate for affected nodes (gpu-17,gpu-23,gpu-41)

jamie-eng: done. rerouting in progress: `route set --prefix /chat/stream region=eu fallback=dedicated-small` — monitoring.

infra-bot: Evacuation request accepted. Queueing drain: gpu-17,gpu-23,gpu-41. Pods will be cordoned and evicted with grace period 30s.

dario-sre: initiating cordon+drain now:
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-17
kubectl drain node/gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

sarah-ml: quick note: moving pods might increase cold-start latency for a subset of users. we've already enabled LRU priming where possible.

tina-oncall: customer-bridge-bot please prepare a short status note for impacted customers: list of instance ids and mitigation steps.

customer-bridge-bot: Draft: "We observed transient driver resets impacting a subset of inference nodes; traffic is being routed to alternate regions and nodes. No model data was lost. We will post follow-up after root cause." — shared to #customer-status for review.

jamie-eng: error rate dropped from 7.2% -> 2.1% after routing change. Still seeing occasional 500 from one pod that restarted twice.

dario-sre: heap/kv cache metrics for model-servlet show memory + page cache growing prior to reset. might be workload-dependent sequence lengths causing larger allocation spikes.

lee-platform: rolling reboots of the affected nodes? recommendation: drain, reboot, hold to observe ECC counters for 1 hour before rejoining.

tina-oncall: agree. plan: drain + reboot GPU hosts, hold for 1h telemetry, then rejoin one at a time. Maintain fallback routing for 2 hours. Escalate to hardware if ECC correctable keeps rising.

dario-sre: started reboot of gpu-17. logs show driver recovered on reinit but repeated Xid 13 on rejoin attempt -> we are holding.

incident-bot: NOTE: escalation policy triggered to hw-team if ECC correctable per-gpu > 200 within 1h window.

jamie-eng: monitoring latency and errors. customer impact: ~1% of total requests experienced transient failures for ~10-30s windows. Top affected customers: a/prod-saas and b/real-time-search. Customer-bridge drafted targeted note.

sarah-ml: can we reduce KV cache size for hot models temporarily to reduce memory pressure? Might buy stability without requeuing too much.

lee-platform: pushing a config change to inference-config: `kv_cache.max_entries: 2e6 -> 1.2e6` as a quick mitigation. Will roll config on non-evac nodes first.

dario-sre: rebooted gpu-17 back online, metrics: ECC correctable down, Xid not observed in last 3m. keeping node in quarantine for 60m.

tina-oncall: okay. continuing to drain+reboot gpu-23 and gpu-41 sequentially. jamie keep routing rule for 2h. sarah/lee coordinate cache config. dario please collect nvbug/kern logs for hw-team attachment.

dario-sre: collected bundle: `/var/log/gpu-telemetry/gpu-17-bundle-4283456789.tar.gz` — uploaded to incidents artifact store and linked in the postmortem stub.

jamie-eng: error rate stable at 0.9% now. canary traffic healthy. customer-bridge posted initial notice and will update in 30m.

tina-oncall: handoff note for next oncall: nodes gpu-17/23/41 quarantined, rejoin criteria: 60m cool window with no Xid, ECC correctable trend flat or decreasing. If Xid recurrence escalate to hw-team. Add to postmortem.

sarah-ml: adding example logs and promptsets to eval to catch regressions (long sequences) before rollout. PR filed: `github.com/redwood/evals#reduce-longseq-cases`.

dario-sre: final ops summary for thread: observed intermittent driver resets (Xid 13) correlated with ECC correctable spikes and KV cache pressure. Mitigations: routing fallback, node drain+reboot, kv_cache cap reduction, quarantined nodes for telemetry. Customer impact limited and being communicated.

tina-oncall: closing paging channel for now. if symptoms return, reopen paging and escalate. :white_check_mark:
